Regardless,specificsystemdesigncriteriaforlocalization performanceshouldbetakenintoaccountwhencommissioninganewSDF-capabledetectorsystem. 2.3 SDF State-of-the-Art As already suggested above, SDF has been applied in a variety of real-world use cases and has been the subject of R&D toward demonstrating the applicability of the SDF concept to many other applications. This section briefly describes the status of SDF R&D as it relates to those applications and as it relates to technologies that are cross cutting in terms of SDF uses. Over 20 prototype LAMP systems have been created by LBNL. These prototypes span from custom-made radiation detector hardware configured in non-trivial geometries to enable both Compton and coded-mask imaging, to simple monolithic detectors, and to simple and complex commercial radiation detector systems. SDF-capable systems have been handheld, contained in backpacks, mounted to UAVs, carried via vehicles in an ad hoc fashion, and integrated into trucks and vans. It can be asserted that the SDF concept has been shown to be usefully applied to free- moving radiation detection across a wide variety of use cases, radiation detector types, and means of mobility. The LBNL-developed SDF technology is capable of running online a SLAM algorithm that producesa3Dmapanddeterminesthe(near)instantaneousstanceofthedetectorsystemwithinthe maps, data acquisition software that processes data from many 10’s of individual radiation sensor modules, and a reconstruction algorithm such as ML-EM or PSL that makes inferences about the radiological nature of the environment. In fact, the LBNL-developed technology has been licensed by a commercial entity, Gamma Reality Inc. (GRI), and is being marketed primarily for use in contamination/radioactivity mapping at nuclear facilities [31]. These GRI systems perform SDF in a qualitative fashion, attributing detected activity to their surroundings and providing outputs to operators that are helpful in guiding operators to find radiological sources or map contamination; they also report measured dose rates at the sensor position.
